summary: Lead research for Artist Commission Form MVP (platform for connecting clients with artists for custom commissions). Targets local artists, art galleries, arts centers, and cultural organizations in Ashtabula County and Northeast Ohio seeking streamlined ways to manage art commissions, custom requests, and client relationships.

leads.fit_rationale: Multi-arts nonprofit offering year-round programming in theater, dance, music, and visual arts with rotating monthly gallery exhibits featuring local, regional, and national artists. Commission form platform would streamline their artist submission process and connect exhibiting artists with potential buyers seeking custom work.

Curated platform listing art calls, grants, fellowships, jobs, and exhibition spaces for Northeast Ohio artists. Artist commission functionality would complement their existing opportunities database and provide another revenue stream for local artists.

Community arts organization offering gallery exhibitions and commission opportunities for working artists. They actively seek commissioned works and maintain portfolios for Artist of the Month selections—digital commission tools would enhance their artist member services.

Regional organization supporting artists with funding resources, professional development, and advocacy. Commission platform would align with their mission to provide access and opportunity to art and culture while supporting artist livelihoods.

leads.organization: Local Artists and Craftsmen in Ashtabula County
leads.fit_rationale: Ashtabula County's tourism economy includes wineries, covered bridges, and local artisans. A commission platform would help connect visiting tourists and residents with local artists for custom pieces, portraits, and regional artwork capturing the area's scenic beauty.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add artist portfolio showcase with high-quality image galleries and artist bios.
Include commission request workflow with project scope, budget, and timeline fields.
Create secure messaging system between clients and artists for project discussions.
Add contract template generator for commission agreements and terms.
Include milestone-based payment tracking and escrow functionality.
Provide review and rating system for completed commissions.
Add art style/category filters (portraits, landscapes, abstract, etc.).
Include artist availability calendar and estimated completion times.
Create sample commission pricing guide for common project types.
Add integration with shipping providers for artwork delivery.
Include copyright and usage rights clarification in commission agreements.
Provide secure file upload for reference images and project briefs.

possible_issues: Art commission platforms must showcase visual work prominently—poor image quality or small galleries hurt artist presentation.
Trust is critical for commission transactions—design must feel professional and secure.
Complex workflows (briefing, revisions, approval) need clear, step-by-step interfaces.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Commission platforms can be white-labeled for individual arts organizations, galleries, or artist collectives with custom branding and artist rosters.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
Contact Ashtabula Arts Center about piloting commission management tools.
Reach out to NEO Opportunities about partnership for artist listings.
Explore integration with existing artist marketplace platforms.
Survey local artists about commission pain points and desired features.
